concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-reference-response-payment-method-nonce-node]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree Node.js website Payment Method Nonce response-reference snapshot whose substantive content is a gateway-returned credit/debit product-ID inventory with generally one-to-three-character IDs and repeated `I` and `MHD` mappings, so it is not a one-code-to-one-product lookup; it does not document nonce creation, lookup, lifespan, consumption, field presence on a particular returned nonce, SDK implementation or payment execution
warnings: The exact page title labels a Payment Method Nonce response route, but the captured body only documents product IDs and repeats `I` and `MHD` for multiple product labels; do not infer a unique product from those codes, and keep nonce lifecycle and operation claims with the dedicated guide and request references.
